## Checklist

- [ ] I inspected the final diff and did not include unrelated changes.
- [ ] Relevant tests and `git diff --check` pass.
- [ ] Public API/event schema/migration/security changes are documented.
- [ ] Performance/security/compliance statements link to saved evidence or are labelled as targets.
- [ ] No secrets or real personal data are included.
